prp.objective: Add a `latest:user` enforcement branch to `protectedOk` in `src/transforms.ts` (the filter's defense-in-depth check, spec/06 §8) so a rewind whose removal set CONTAINS the index of the LAST `role:"user"` message is REFUSED (returns false). This is the FILTER half of BUG-003; the rewind-tool pre-persist guard is the sibling task P1.M2.T2.S2 and is out of scope. Mirror the existing `first:user` discipline exactly (fail-safe: malformed/missing `protectedRoles` → enforce; config omitting `latest:user` → not enforced; NEVER throws). Add the 4 contract unit tests (a–d) to `test/pipeline.test.ts`'s `protectedOk` describe block and update the ONE existing test whose single-user fixture + `remove=[0]` would now trip `latest:user`. All existing first:user tests must stay green.
implementationSteps: MODIFY src/transforms.ts:767 `protectedOk` — replace its body with the target refactored source: keep the two top guards (empty/non-array remove → true; non-array messages → true); compute `hasRoles = Array.isArray(roles) && roles.length > 0` then `protectFirstUser = !hasRoles || roles.some(r=>r==="first:user")` and `protectLatestUser = !hasRoles || roles.some(r=>r==="latest:user")` INDEPENDENTLY; REMOVE the old `if (!protectFirstUser) return true;` early-return; convert the first:user block to refuse-and-fall-through (`if (Number.isFinite(minRemove) && minRemove <= iFirstUser) return false;`); ADD the latest:user block after it (compute iLatestUser = LAST role:"user" index, no break; `if (iLatestUser !== -1 && remove.some(r => r === iLatestUser)) return false;`); final `return true`. Use only the in-scope module-private isRecord()/readOwn(); add NO imports (transforms.ts stays Pi-free/zero-import). Update the docstring to mention both selectors.

MODIFY test/pipeline.test.ts — in the `describe("protectedOk — spec/06 §8", ...)` block, UPDATE the existing test "protectedRoles omitting first:user → true (disabled)": its config `{ rewind: { protectedRoles: ["latest:user"] } }` now enables latest:user, so change the fixture to a TWO-user list `[user("u0"), asst("c"), result("c"), user("u1")]` (iFirstUser=0, iLatestUser=3) keeping `remove=[0]` and the `true` expectation — this preserves the test's intent (first:user disabled) without tripping the now-active latest:user check.

MODIFY test/pipeline.test.ts — ADD 4 unit tests to the protectedOk describe block (after existing first:user tests, before the next describe), using the file-level `cfg` (both selectors) unless noted: (a) `[user("u0"), asst("c"), result("c"), user("u1 LATEST"), asst("work")]` with `remove=[3]` and `remove=[3,4]` → both `false` (checkpoint-style remove containing iLatestUser); (b) `[user("u0"), asst("c"), result("c"), user("u1 LATEST")]` with `remove=[1]` and `remove=[1,2]` → both `true` (remove misses iLatestUser); (c) config `{ rewind: { protectedRoles: ["first:user"] } }` (latest:user omitted), `[user("u0"), asst("c"), user("u1 LATEST")]`, `remove=[2]` → `true` (latest:user not enforced); (d) `[user("only"), asst("c"), result("c")]`, `remove=[0]`, default cfg → `false` (single user; iFirstUser===iLatestUser; both selectors agree).

VERIFY: run `npx tsc --noEmit` (zero errors), then `npx vitest run test/pipeline.test.ts -t "protectedOk"` (all existing + updated + 4 new green), then `npx vitest run` (full suite green — confirms edge-cases.test.ts E3 protectedOk block and filter.test.ts are unaffected). Do NOT edit any file outside src/transforms.ts and test/pipeline.test.ts.

successCriteria.description: protectedOk returns false when `remove` contains the index of the LAST role:"user" message and "latest:user" is in config.rewind.protectedRoles (test a).
protectedOk returns true when `remove` does NOT contain iLatestUser, even if it removes other content after iFirstUser (test b).
When protectedRoles omits "latest:user" (e.g. ["first:user"]), latest:user is not enforced — protectedOk returns true even if remove contains iLatestUser (test c).
Single-user session (iFirstUser===iLatestUser) with remove containing that index returns false — both selectors agree (test d).
protectLatestUser defaults to true (enforce) when protectedRoles is absent/empty/malformed, independently of protectFirstUser (fail-safe; mirror of first:user discipline).
All existing protectedOk first:user tests stay green, including test/edge-cases.test.ts E3 block and test/filter.test.ts (full suite green).
protectedOk NEVER throws (E13) and adds no imports — transforms.ts remains Pi-free/zero-import; only src/transforms.ts and test/pipeline.test.ts are modified.
